name: arcade
description: A complete arcade game from a one-paragraph idea, judged by hidden playtests on the conventions every game must follow (state, start, controls, pause, no errors) plus its own gates.

input.idea: Asteroid Miner: a 2D arcade game. The player pilots a mining ship (rotate with left/right, thrust with up, shoot with space) in a wrapping asteroid field. Big rocks split into smaller ones when shot; small ones drop ore crystals the ship collects by flying through them. Score for rocks and ore; a life is lost on collision (3 lives, brief invulnerability after respawn). Waves get bigger. Title screen, pause, game over with best score, restart.
